title: storyink, one week in
subtitle: From a JSON diagram renderer to change stories and explainer pages, 25 September to 2 October 2026.
summary: storyink turns a JSON spec (or Mermaid) into a standalone, offline HTML page and SVG. In a week it grew a storyboard engine, an animated SVG that plays inside a README ``, rich panels and code, and change stories that walk a reviewer through a diff. This page is itself a storyink page.

kpis.label: Single diagram
kpis.detail: checkout example, font and viewer included

figure.claim: Everything renders from one **scene**: core is browser-safe and pure, and Node only adds files, git and a headless browser.

timeline.title: First release
timeline.body: Spec, validation, Mermaid import, layout, SSR and viewer, CLI, OpenCode plugin.

timeline.title: Storyboard mode
timeline.body: `story` steps and `"story": "auto"`, a pure `storyState(t)`, viewer playback.

timeline.title: Animated SVG (SMIL)
timeline.body: The story plays inside a plain ``, so READMEs and PRs animate without script.

timeline.title: Playback fixes and reading holds
timeline.body: Reduced-motion stepped playback, follow camera, step moves, reading holds and the default pace of 0.6.

timeline.title: Rich panels, code animation, SVG parity
timeline.body: `panel`, `code` and `chip` nodes, anchors, content steps; the animated SVG covers them.

timeline.title: Change stories and pages
timeline.body: Deltas, diff ingestion, diff code nodes, narration and the drawer; then `type: "page"` documents.

decisions.decision: Core stays browser-safe: no Node APIs.
decisions.why: The same code renders in the CLI, the plugin and the browser.

decisions.decision: Validation never throws; it returns diagnostics with JSON paths and hints.
decisions.why: Agents fix specs from the messages alone.

decisions.decision: New looks are additive: palettes and CSS are emitted only when a scene uses them.
decisions.why: Old diagrams render byte-identically, pinned by golden tests.

decisions.decision: The font is embedded, so output works offline.
decisions.why: Commit Mono is base64 inside every page and static SVG.

checklist.text: Pages: interactive figures hydrate in page mode
checklist.note: viewer half of the pages work, landing alongside this page

checklist.text: Smaller pages: the viewer bundle is the largest part of every file
